controls.title: Logical access — identification & authentication
controls.vertirite_mechanism: Mutual TLS + signed JWT (ES256); per-tenant isolation.

controls.title: System monitoring for anomalies
controls.vertirite_mechanism: Continuous discovery of ungoverned AI/automation + real-time alerting on new threats.

controls.title: Incident evaluation & response
controls.vertirite_mechanism: Human-in-the-loop approval queue + out-of-band LOCKDOWN mode authority.

controls.title: Change management
controls.vertirite_mechanism: Capability registry — adding a capability is a code-reviewed change.

controls.title: Audit trail / availability of evidence
controls.vertirite_mechanism: Audit log of every governed action and approval decision (authenticated actor, action, time), rows tagged by tenant.

disclaimer: Maps Vertirite mechanisms to framework controls with the evidence in this pack. Not an assertion of certification.
